additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0461831
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-ES SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / S3 300000004065
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
Please measure the Voltage between the 24V supply on the PCB.
If the Voltage is between 24/25V and the HMI is not OK
Verify if the DP cable is properly attached
If both are OK then replace the HMI
I will send you all the necessary references for the specific HMI required for this charger
-
8EM5902-1AA00-6AA1 -PH9 Controlpanel RAFI 3 segments w/o AC cutout
-
8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8 -PH11 Controlp. RAFI middle segm. contactl. CCR
-Adaptation 8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-ES SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at

.

Thank you.
With best regards,

Younes Baroudi

additional_info.subject: Chargers are fully operationals even with the degradated HMI: A new HMI is expected to be installed in both SiD units next week.
additional_info.body:
Fully operational chargers with degraded HMIs over the past few months.
We proposed replacing the HMIs to the customer during the warranty period.
Over the past few months, we were in discussions with the support team to upgrade the HMIs to the new RAFI 3-segment hardware revision.
We finally received authorization to do so under the factory warranty.

additional_info.subject: HMIs already installed in both SiD
